title: Analytics candidate-facing fixture contract v3
description: v3 additionally requires every case to state whether the registered window has completed, so the claim-scope rule is checked against a declared fact rather than parsed out of a prose maturity description.

arms.description: Identifiers an action may target. operational.target must be exactly one of these.

registered_window_complete.description: True when the registered observation window has closed. False means the registered estimand is right-censored and only an interim outcome exists.
